objects.canonical_form: FailAdmFix(C) := classified failure state when CandFix(C) does not satisfy fixed-point admissibility conditions
objects.formal_definition: The classified failure state produced when CandFix(C) does not satisfy fixed-point admissibility conditions.

objects.title: Fixed-Point Correctness
objects.canonical_form: CorrectFix(C) := correctness classification assigned to an admissible fixed point under bounded continuation-semantics preservation
objects.formal_definition: The correctness classification assigned to an admissible fixed point that satisfies the declared continuation semantics under bounded repeated applications of the declared fixed-point operator.

objects.title: Fixed-Point Correctness Theorem
objects.canonical_form: ThmCorrectFix := bounded correctness theorem for admissible continuation fixed points
objects.formal_definition: The bounded theorem that an admissible fixed point is correct when bounded evaluation preserves continuation semantics under repeated applications of the declared fixed-point operator.

objects.title: Fixed-Point Correctness Failure
objects.canonical_form: FailCorrectFix(C) := classified failure state when admissible fixed-point correctness verification fails
objects.formal_definition: The classified failure state produced when an admissible fixed point fails correctness verification.

objects.title: Fixed-Point Uniqueness
objects.canonical_form: UniqueFix(C) := uniqueness classification for a correct fixed point within its declared bounded equivalence class
objects.formal_definition: The condition that a correct fixed point is the only continuation fixed point satisfying the declared bounded fixed-point semantics within its fixed-point class and evaluation regime.

objects.title: Fixed-Point Equivalence Class
objects.canonical_form: EqClassFix(C) := {C' | C' is equivalent to C under the declared continuation, trace, and fixed-point evaluation semantics}
objects.formal_definition: The class of fixed-point candidates considered equivalent under the declared continuation, trace, and fixed-point evaluation semantics.

objects.title: Fixed-Point Uniqueness Failure
objects.canonical_form: FailUniqueFix(C) := classified failure state when more than one non-equivalent correct fixed point exists in the bounded class
objects.formal_definition: The classified failure state produced when more than one non-equivalent correct fixed point exists within the declared bounded fixed-point class.

objects.title: Recursive Fixed-Point Interaction
objects.canonical_form: RecFix(C) := bounded semantic relation between recursive continuation evaluation Rec(C) and fixed-point evaluation EvalPhi(C)
objects.formal_definition: The bounded semantic relation between recursive continuation evaluation Rec(C) and fixed-point evaluation EvalPhi(C).

objects.title: Recursive Fixed-Point Alignment
objects.canonical_form: AlignRecFix(C) := bounded condition where recursive unfolding and fixed-point evaluation preserve equivalent continuation semantics
objects.formal_definition: The condition where recursive continuation unfolding and fixed-point evaluation preserve the same continuation semantics within the declared bounded regime.

objects.title: Recursive Fixed-Point Divergence
objects.canonical_form: DivRecFix(C) := bounded condition where recursive unfolding does not align with fixed-point evaluation
objects.formal_definition: The classified condition where recursive unfolding does not align with bounded fixed-point evaluation.

objects.title: Recursive Fixed-Point Interaction Failure
objects.canonical_form: FailRecFix(C) := classified failure state when the recursive/fixed-point interaction cannot be typed, bounded, or compared under the declared regime
objects.formal_definition: The failure state produced when recursive/fixed-point interaction cannot be typed, bounded, or evaluated under the declared regime.
